caption: The single permitted project action advances through the runtime rail in source order.
code:
flowchart TB
  S1_INSTALL["S1.INSTALL · init"]
  S2_GOAL_LOCK["S2.GOAL_LOCK · goal set"]
  S1_INSTALL --> S2_GOAL_LOCK
  S3_WORK_OPENED["S3.WORK_OPENED · wp new"]
  S2_GOAL_LOCK --> S3_WORK_OPENED
  S4_DOCUMENTS_CREATED["S4.DOCUMENTS_CREATED · doc new"]
  S3_WORK_OPENED --> S4_DOCUMENTS_CREATED
  S5_DOCUMENTS_AUTHORED["S5.DOCUMENTS_AUTHORED · doc step"]
  S4_DOCUMENTS_CREATED --> S5_DOCUMENTS_AUTHORED
  S6_DOCUMENTS_SEALED["S6.DOCUMENTS_SEALED · doc seal"]
  S5_DOCUMENTS_AUTHORED --> S6_DOCUMENTS_SEALED
  S7_EVIDENCE["S7.EVIDENCE · evidence add"]
  S6_DOCUMENTS_SEALED --> S7_EVIDENCE
  S8_GATE["S8.GATE · gate run"]
  S7_EVIDENCE --> S8_GATE
  S9_WORK_COMPLETED["S9.WORK_COMPLETED · wp complete"]
  S8_GATE --> S9_WORK_COMPLETED
  S10_CHECKPOINT["S10.CHECKPOINT · checkpoint"]
  S9_WORK_COMPLETED --> S10_CHECKPOINT
  S11_SECOND_PASS["S11.SECOND_PASS · pass2"]
  S10_CHECKPOINT --> S11_SECOND_PASS
  S12_VERIFIED["S12.VERIFIED · verify --record"]
  S11_SECOND_PASS --> S12_VERIFIED
  S13_RELEASED["S13.RELEASED · release"]
  S12_VERIFIED --> S13_RELEASED
insight: The rail puts document creation and sealing before evidence and gates, then requires checkpoint, a non-author pass, recorded verification, and release.

  D7_MACHINE --> D8_TESTS

caption: Every mutating command follows the same write order.
code:
sequenceDiagram
  participant CLI
  participant Rail
  participant Artifact
  participant Ledger
  participant State
  CLI->>Rail: authorize requested command
  Rail-->>CLI: permitted step or refusal
  CLI->>Artifact: write bounded artifact
  CLI->>Ledger: append hash-chained entry
  CLI->>State: update durable state
  State-->>CLI: exact next action
insight: Authorization precedes every write; the ledger entry precedes the state update so a crash leaves evidence of an unapplied action rather than unrecorded state.
reader_question: What is written first, and what may not happen until when?
title: Governed mutation write order

caption: One release version lives in four artifacts; the labeled edges name the check codes that compare each one back to VERSION.
code:
flowchart LR
  Version["VERSION"] --> Manifest["MODULE_MANIFEST.yaml × 33"]
  Version --> Narrative["MODULE.md front matter × 33"]
  Version --> Framework["docs/registries/FRAMEWORK.json"]
  Version --> Allowlist["RELEASE_ALLOWLIST.json"]
  Manifest -.->|"MODULE_RELEASE_PIN_DRIFT"| Version
  Narrative -.->|"MODULE_NARRATIVE_MISSING, MODULE_NARRATIVE_RELEASE_DRIFT"| Version
  Framework -.->|"FRAMEWORK_REGISTRY_RELEASE_DRIFT"| Version
  Allowlist -.->|"ALLOWLIST_RELEASE_DRIFT"| Version
insight: Four structure codes and one governance code turn a decorative pin into a read one; before 1.3.0 nothing compared the narrative to its manifest.
